rule: Each plan case of the group, in plan order, in two parts kept apart as the plan's SOURCE_AND_INSTALLED_MIGRATION evidence asks (`part`): the SOURCE cases are checked against source (S44 offline through the contracts' reference models, the three MATRIX cases as source tests of W05's released build), and the INSTALLED case repeats the same contract rows on the enrolled hosts in W06. S44 lists one property per sentence of W02D section 4.4; each catalog row whose basis starts with a property's text serves that property. A property is PASS only when every one of its vectors replayed and passed in this run, and NOT_RUN_ENV_UNAVAILABLE when its replay needs what the verifier profile lacks (owner decisions Q-T4 and Q-T20); S44 is PASS only when every property is. A case that waits for W05's release set or for W06's native hosts is NOT_RUN_ENV_UNAVAILABLE, never PASS (AGENTS rule 14), and its catalog names the contract vectors whose own expected results are its expected results (owner decision Q-T8).
